notes:
- Company profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (workflow & orchestration platform). Heavy emphasis on in-app assistants + search for European customers.
- Current evaluation path: POC running on Redwood Hosted API (EU region). If POC meets latency/cost targets, they will move to a Dedicated footprint for tenancy guarantees and predictable throughput.

Need per-route routing policy + automatic fallback to compatible model variant in another region under capacity events.

- Quotes/feedback from calls: "If EU tenancy costs us +25% but avoids legal hold-ups we will take it" — Head of Product.
